decision.message: The request to keep two copper layers and resize the board to 80x60 mm is supported within the esp32_bmp280_v1 family with the standard profile. Operating limits are preserved as per family specifications.

clauses.reason: Two copper layers are preserved as per the existing board design.

clauses.text: but make the complete controller board 80 by 60 millimeters.
clauses.reason: The board size request modifies the standard 120x80 mm to a smaller 80x60 mm, which is a supported change in dimension but does not specify a profile, so 'standard' is used by default.
